C0675.title: WeChat Begins Gray-Testing Custom Red Packet Cover Feature
C0675.summary: In January 2025, after updating to iOS version 8.0.55, WeChat started gray-testing a feature allowing individual users to customize red packet covers. Users can tap 'Change Style' in the red packet interface to access the customization page and upload multiple images. The feature currently supports only static images, with no support for animated or video content. Allowing arbitrary image uploads
